command: set -u; PID=$(systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -p MainPID --value); echo '=== descendants ==='; pstree -ap "$PID" 2>/dev/null | head -120 || true; echo '=== direct children ==='; ps --ppid "$PID" -o pid,ppid,etimes,stat,%cpu,%mem,cmd || true; echo '=== aplay/curl/ollama related ==='; ps -eo pid,ppid,etimes,stat,%cpu,%mem,cmd | grep -E 'aplay|curl.*11434|ollama|gpt-realtime|voice_final_runtime' | grep -v grep | head -100 || true; echo '=== zombies systemwide ==='; ps -eo stat,pid,ppid,etimes,comm,args | awk '$1 ~ /^Z/ {print}' | head -80; echo ZOMBIE_COUNT=$(ps -eo stat= | awk '$1 ~ /^Z/ {n++} END {print n+0}'); echo '=== sockets ==='; ss -tpn 2>/dev/null | grep "pid=$PID," | head -40 || true
